target_condition.evidence_quote: samples from four families with multiple cases of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM)

westernized.notes: Not explicitly labeled as 'westernized' in the text, though cohort is from Luxembourg.

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: extraction using the All-In-One kit (Norgen Biotek) to recover DNA and proteins were carried out as previously described
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Extraction of biomolecular fractions from faecal samples
dna_extraction_kit.notes: DNA fractions were also supplemented using the MOBIO Power Soil Kit ('PowerSoil'), and RNA extraction used the MOBIO PowerMicrobiome RNA Isolation Kit; multiple kits were used across omic levels.

ncbi_accession.evidence_quote: Metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequencing reads can be accessed from NCBI BioProject PRJNA289586

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: DNA was sequenced with 101 bp (per paired end) on a HiSeq2000 system (Illumina) by BGI
sequencing_platform.section: Methods — Metagenomic DNA and RNA sequencing
sequencing_platform.notes: Metatranscriptomic cDNA libraries were sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq2500 platform; both are Illumina HiSeq instruments.

family_role.notes: Family pedigrees with generational structure are shown in Figure 1a but specific mother/father/child role labels per individual are not enumerated in the extracted text.

feces_phenotype.notes: Fecal samples were used for metagenomic/metatranscriptomic/metaproteomic analyses, but no specific stool phenotype (e.g., consistency score) reported.

fmt_id.notes: Not applicable; not an FMT study.

hla.notes: HLA typing not reported, though genetic risk of T1DM is discussed generally.

neonatal_birth_weight.notes: Not applicable; adult/child family cohort, no birth data reported.

treatment.evidence_quote: successfully controlled by insulin replacement therapy
treatment.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures
treatment.notes: Some T1DM individuals also reported as taking thiamine supplements, mentioned only for a subset in context of thiamine analysis.

tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: Not applicable; not a cancer study.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: α-amylase proteins AMY2A and AMY2B (Fig. 5a,b), carboxypeptidase CPA1 and the less characterized CUZD1
biomarker_name.section: Results — Human protein excretion in T1DM and microbial functions
biomarker_name.notes: Also includes LTF (lactotransferrin) and ITLN1 (intelectin), reported as higher in T1DM; AMY2A, AMY2B, CPA1, CUZD1 reported as lower in T1DM.

biomarker_unit.notes: Units for AMY2A and AMY2B given as relative protein abundance (%) in Fig. 5 axis labels; no explicit units reported in main text for CPA1, CUZD1, LTF, or ITLN1 abundances.

biomarker_value.evidence_quote: to be less abundant in the stool of individuals with T1DM, potentially reflecting a weakening of exocrine function
biomarker_value.section: Results — Human protein excretion in T1DM and microbial functions
biomarker_value.notes: Exact numeric abundance values not stated in main text (only shown graphically in Fig. 5a,b and Supplementary Table 5); direction of change (higher/lower in T1DM vs healthy) is explicitly stated.

disease_response_os.notes: This is a microbiome multi-omics study of familial T1DM, not a survival/oncology study; overall survival is not applicable.

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable to this study design.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status is not relevant to this T1DM microbiome case study and is not reported.

feces_phenotype_value.notes: No feces phenotype scoring (e.g., Bristol stool scale) is reported; only sample collection and biomolecular extraction details are given.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this is not an oncology study.
